claim: On October 23 USDA announced up to $31.7 million in Vermont farm and timber disaster recovery assistance with an October 26–December 31 application window.
verifiedFacts: USDA FSA's October 23 notice says Vermont producers can apply for up to $31.7 million under a state-administered block grant.
The program addresses qualifying weather-related agricultural, timber, and on-farm infrastructure losses from 2023 and 2024.
Applications for the state program and reopened Emergency Forest Restoration Program run October 26 through December 31, 2026.
